args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1, error rate 0.18). Rolled back in all regions to v2.2.9, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note: v2.3.0 (the immediately preceding healthy release) is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417 and could not be used.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy (v2.3.1, error rate 0.18) across all regions.
2. Attempted to roll back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release), but it was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
3. Rolled back to **v2.2.9** — the most recent release that was healthy in production and not quarantined — in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollout succeeded.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the failure and the rollback (including the note that v2.3.0 was skipped due to the CVE quarantine). On-call has been paged.
